newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-UNITED WIN 4-0, LIVERPOOL, NEWCASTLE STUMBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNITED WIN 4-0, LIVERPOOL, NEWCASTLE STUMBLE.

text.p: Champions Manchester United won 4-0 at Nottingham Forest on Thursday and took advantage of suprises elsewhere to move into third in the English premier league.

Leaders Liverpool fought back from 1-0 down but were still held 1-1 at home to mid-table Leicester while relegation-threatened Blackburn ruined Alan Shearer's return to Ewood Park by beating Newcastle 1-0.
Two goals from Italian Gianfranco Zola gave Chelsea a 2-0 victory at in-form Aston Villa while Everton lost 4-2 at Middlesbrough.
Third-placed Wimbledon's match against West Ham was postponed because of a frozen pitch.
Arsenal, in second place at the start of the day, were due to play Sheffield Wednesday later on Thursday.
